The National Weather Service in Greenville-Spartanburg has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Davie County in the Piedmont of North Carolina...

* Until 445 PM EDT.

* At 411 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles north of
Mocksville, or 5 miles west of Bermuda Run, moving northeast at 15
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind
damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Bermuda Run and Farmington.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
For the following areas...
Waters from Manasquan Inlet NJ to Little Egg Inlet NJ from 20 to 60
NM...

At 409 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 41 nm east of Garden State North Reef, moving southeast
at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to 40 knots, and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.region: Oceana; Muskegon; Ottawa; Allegan; Van Buren
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...High wave action, strong currents, and dangerous
swimming conditions expected. Piers may be heavily swamped by
waves.

* WHERE...Oceana, Muskegon, Ottawa, Allegan and Van Buren
counties.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong currents can pull swimmers into deeper water
and high waves can sweep people off piers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Beaches north of piers will tend to have
the most hazardous currents today which can pull swimmers into
deeper water.

* WHERE...Portions of Southwest and southwest Indiana, including the
following counties, in Southwest Indiana, Posey. In southwest
Indiana, Vanderburgh and Warrick.

* WHEN...Until 615 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.

Evansville, Darmstadt, Kasson, Blairsville and Elberfeld.
